flavor: A delicious meal made on your Biofuel Stove.
description: A savory pastry baked until golden.

title: Soy Bean
intro: Soy Beans are a common form of Plantlife found in the Forest and Riverlands Regions on Icarus.
flavor: The argument over whether soy produces 'milk' or 'juice' rages into the 22nd century.
description: Close to to the perfect food source.

title: Soy Bean Stir-Fry
intro: Soy Bean Stir-Fry is a Food with a unique Status Effect, which can be stacked with other food buffs. Can be eaten to satisfy Hunger.
flavor: One of the original crops intended to sustain humanity on its first new extra-solar world.
description: Boosts health, lifts stamina, enhances self-satisfaction.

title: Sprinters Animal Feed
intro: Sprinters Animal Feed is a Food for Pets or Mounts with a unique Status Effect. Can be eaten to satisfy Hunger. Sprinters Animal Feed decays in 10,800 seconds, but that decay can be slowed down by storing Sprinters Animal Feed inside an Ice Box or Refrigerator.
flavor: Feeding time at the zoo.
description: A feed that promotes short and fast travel.

title: Squash
intro: Squash are a common form of Plantlife found in the Desert Region on Icarus. When consumed by prospectors, they replenish Hunger.
flavor: A myriad of squash varieties exist, but the effects of genetic tampering by xeno-biologiest have resulted in a variant with noticeable endurance-enhancing qualities.
description: An edible herbaceous vine fruit.

title: Stew
intro: Stew is a Food with a unique Status Effect, which can be stacked with other food buffs. Can be eaten to satisfy Hunger.
flavor: Some foods profit from rustic conditions. Boosts health, lifts stamina.
description: A rich, nourishing casserole.

title: Strawberry
intro: Strawberry is a Food with a unique Status Effect, which can be stacked with other food buffs. Can be eaten to satisfy Hunger. Strawberries are not found natively on Icarus, however they can be received as rewards from SMPL3 quests obtained at the C0NT4CT Device in Open World and Outposts, or purchased in the Workshop in the form of a Strawberry Farming Packet and grown by a prospector.
flavor: The average berry contains around 200 tiny seeds
description: A sweet and juicy fruit with a bright red colour.

title: Strawberry Jam
intro: Strawberry Jam is a long-lasting Food with a unique Status Effect, which can be stacked with other food buffs. Strawberry Jam, Berry Jam and Pickled Carrot, do not spoil and is therefore a valuable food for long-term storage.
flavor: A handy snack made at your Kitchen Bench.
description: A sweet and fruity spread.

title: Stuffed Avocado
intro: Stuffed Avocado is a Food with a unique Status Effect, which can be stacked with other food buffs. Can be eaten to satisfy Hunger.
flavor: Another great meal from your Cooking Station.
description: This avocado has been halved and filled with a savory mixture.

title: Sugar Cane
intro: Sugar Cane does not naturally spawn on Icarus and is obtainable through the Orbital Exchange Interface once researched through the Workshop Farming section. It costs 50 credits to Research and 20 credits to Craft each (gives 5x seeds per 1x Farming Packet). Shipped directly from off-world, this item is essential for food crafting recipes that grants the player additional buffs.
flavor: Sweet As.
description: A piece of raw sugar cane, ready for processing.

title: Sugar Cubes
intro: This item is essential for food crafting recipes that grants the player additional buffs.
flavor: Sweet As.
description: A handful of sweet sugar cubes.

title: Sweetcorn Soup
intro: Sweetcorn Soup is a Food with a unique Status Effect, which can be stacked with other food buffs. Can be eaten to satisfy Hunger.
flavor: Boosts stamina and improves endurance. Drains nostalgia.
description: A classic dish, even without shredded chicken.

title: Tea Smoked Freshwater Fillet
intro: Tea Smoked Freshwater Fillet is a Food with a unique Status Effect, which can be stacked with other food buffs. Can be eaten to satisfy Hunger.
flavor: UDA reports have mixed results on the flavor.
description: A tender snack made by smoking and preserving tender fillets of freshwater fish.

title: Tomato & Egg Bowl
intro: Tomato & Egg Bowl is a Food with a unique Status Effect, which can be stacked with other food buffs. Can be eaten to satisfy Hunger.
flavor: An interesting mix of protein and fruit.
description: Considered a delicacy back on Earth
buffs: 15% Chance to find additional Stone while Mining

title: Tomato Soup
intro: Tomato Soup is a consumable Food crafted from Tomatoes and Water. As Tomatoes are only found on Prometheus, this recipe requires the New Frontiers DLC to obtain the ingredients.
flavor: So tasty.
description: Boosts stamina and health regeneration.
bench: Biofuel Stove Electric Stove Potbelly Stove

title: Vegetable Pie
intro: Vegetable Pie is a Food with a unique Status Effect, which can be stacked with other food buffs. Can be eaten to satisfy Hunger. "Warm, health-giving, stamina-boosting - virtue in every pie."
flavor: If this pie had a slogan, it might be 'Stay delicious'.
description: Warm, health-giving, stamina-boosting - virtue in every pie.
buffs: * +150 Maximum Health * +150 Maximum Stamina * -15% Stamina Consumed by Actions * +15% Melee Damage * +10% Experience Gained

title: Vegetable Roll
intro: Vegetable Roll is a Food with a unique Status Effect, which can be stacked with other food buffs. Can be eaten to satisfy Hunger.
flavor: A delicious meal made on your Biofuel Stove.
description: An easy choice packed with veges.

title: Volcanic Animal Feed
intro: Volcanic Animal Feed is a Food for Pets or Mounts with a unique Status Effect. Can be eaten to satisfy Hunger. Volcanic Animal Feed decays in 10,800 seconds, but that decay can be slowed down by storing Volcanic Animal Feed inside an Ice Box or Refrigerator.
flavor: Feeding time at the zoo.
description: A feed that will help animals survive volcanic environments.

title: Watermelon
intro: Watermelons are a common form of Plantlife found in the Forest and Riverlands Regions on Icarus. When consumed by Prospectors, they replenish Hunger and Thirst.
flavor: Icarus produces approximately 0.003% of humanity's watermelons.
description: Mainly water and sugar.

title: Wild Berry
intro: Wild Berry are a common form of Plantlife found in the Forest and Riverlands Regions on Icarus. When consumed by prospectors, they replenish both the Hunger and Thirst meters.
flavor: The intrepid prospector may also ferment wine, trusting that the quality of the resulting beverage is less important than the sheer fact of its existence.
description: Berries will satisfy hunger, hydrate slightly, and extend endurance, but not for long.

title: Wild Salad
intro: Wild Salad is a Food with a unique Status Effect, which can be stacked with other food buffs. Can be eaten to satisfy Hunger. Wild Salad decays, but that decay can be slowed down by storing Wild Salad inside an Ice Box or Refrigerator.
flavor: At home among the stars, yet no closer to answering the age old question: 'What is a salad, exactly?'
description: Mixed pieces of squash and pumpkin at room temperature.

title: Young Coconut
intro: Harvested from palm trees in the Desert, when chopping their tops with an axe. If a prospector lets it decay, it will ripen into a Ripe Coconut.
flavor: Like sharks, coconuts often fail to live up to their lethal reputation.
description: Mostly water, young coconuts will quench thirst, but wont do much for hunger.
